_comment: Delegation modes. 'instruction' is what Claude is told at session start; only 'off' is enforced by the server (delegate and analyze refuse).

off.description: Delegation disabled: the delegation tools refuse to run. For repos whose code must not be sent to external services.
off.instruction: Delegation is OFF here: delegate and analyze will refuse. Work as usual without them.

manual.description: Delegate only when the user asks (in the conversation, with a /capocantiere command, or in CLAUDE.md).
manual.instruction: Delegate to workers only when the user explicitly asks for it (in the conversation, with a /capocantiere command, or in CLAUDE.md). Otherwise work as usual.

auto.description: Claude decides case by case whether a worker, itself or a Claude subagent fits best.
auto.instruction: Delegate to a worker when it clearly fits (see the worker-delegation skill); otherwise do the work yourself or use a Claude subagent. Explicit user instructions and CLAUDE.md take precedence.

prefer.description: Delegate everything that makes sense to delegate; Claude keeps design, delicate parts, review and verification.
prefer.instruction: Actively look for work to delegate to workers (delegate for code, analyze for exploring) and keep design, delicate parts, review and verification for yourself. Explicit user instructions and CLAUDE.md take precedence.
